$schema.description: UI schema v1: views written for an older major are migrated, newer ones refused.

overlay.description: Hosted beside the app's main view: its root is a Stack of dialogs and side sheets that show only when their view models open them (Settings, the theme manager).

c_Text.description: A run of interface text. Note text is never rendered with this; it lives in block components.

c_Heading.description: An interface heading for a sheet, dialog, or section.

c_Icon.description: A Fluent UI System icon. Decorative unless it has a label.

c_Button.description: A labelled action. Its label says what it does.

c_IconButton.description: An icon-only action with a required label, shown as its tooltip and accessible name.

c_Tooltip.description: Shows a control's name and shortcut. Never holds information you can't get another way.

c_SignalDot.description: The red dot. Its tone signals a save problem on the trigger.

c_TriggerButton.description: The frosted circle with the red dot. The Trigger compound places it and gives it behavior.

c_Divider.description: Separates groups in menus and toolbars.

c_PopoverPanel.description: A frosted panel anchored to its trigger. Esc and clicking outside close it.

c_MenuButton.description: A button that opens a menu of commands, each showing its state and shortcut: an icon, a quiet text pill, or text with a chevron (Turn into).

c_Shortcut.description: A key chord drawn as key caps in the platform's symbols, read aloud in words.

c_SearchField.description: A search box with a clear button. Esc clears it, or passes on when it's already empty.

c_SegmentedControl.description: Two to five mutually exclusive choices drawn as segments, with a visible label.

c_DialogPanel.description: The modal surface behind every dialog: scrim, raised or frosted panel, a title row, fixed controls, a scrolling body, and a footer.

c_Spinner.description: An indeterminate wait sign. Stands still with reduced motion.

c_LiveRegion.description: A polite screen-reader announcement with nothing on screen.

c_Toast.description: A one-sentence confirmation with an optional action. Pauses while hovered or focused; Esc dismisses it.

c_ResultList.description: A list box of results whose owner keeps focus and moves the active item (aria-activedescendant). Header items head labeled groups; highlights mark where the query matched; a row can show its state.

c_Tabs.description: A tab list and the selected tab's panel. The view switches the panel content on the value.

c_MorphPanel.description: A trigger that morphs into its panel: the circle grows into the panel's shape, and the content fades in after it.

c_TextField.description: A labelled single-line field, with an optional description. Secrets use type password.

c_PillButton.description: A small, quiet text button in a pill: muted until pointed at or focused.

c_FileTree.description: The Files tree: rows with levels, multiple selection, type-ahead, drag and drop onto folders, and an inline name field.

c_VersionPane.description: One version of a note in the conflict resolver: its blocks as plain text, with the blocks that differ from the other version highlighted.

c_WindowControls.description: The app-drawn minimize, maximize or restore, and close buttons of the Windows and Linux window (D-15), shown on hover, keyboard focus, or while the window isn't active, with the Snap Layouts picker on the maximize button.

c_ThemeGallery.description: The theme manager's gallery (IA-VIEW-THEME): a tile per theme with a sample of its colors. Arrow keys move in two dimensions and preview, Enter or a click chooses, and Esc stops a preview.

c_Slider.description: A labelled slider for a number on steps, showing its value in words (Theme manager → Reading).

c_ColorField.description: A labelled hex color field with a swatch (Theme manager → Edit colors). The value is committed on Enter or on leaving the field, so typing never applies half a color.

c_AppMark.description: The Focus Notes app icon (the red dot in a frosted circle, on paper), drawn from the brand tokens (a dark tile in a dark theme, D-135): the hero of the full-window setup (D-126). Decorative unless it has a label.

c_StepMark.description: A setup step's hero: one icon in a large tile, the step's visual anchor (D-127, D-135). Toned for a problem or success; while the step waits, a ring turns around it (still with reduced motion). Decorative unless it has a label.

c_ItemCard.description: One thing, shown rather than described (D-126, D-127): an account (its picture or initials, name and @login), a workspace (an icon, its name, when it was updated and a Public or Private badge), or an option. Its actions go in its slot.

c_SaveState.description: Where saving stands, as one muted icon in a quiet pill: its words are the tooltip and name, and pressing it backs up now (EDT-11, D-132).

c_StepDots.description: Where the setup is (D-142): one dot per step, the steps done filled, the current one a longer segment. Named as a whole (Step 2 of 4); the dots themselves are decorative.

c_StatusRow.description: One status, shown not told (D-142): an icon and one short sentence on a tinted row, near the top of what it's about. Every setup problem uses it; the field at fault also says why on itself. Announced politely when it appears.

c_CodeBlock.description: Something to type or paste elsewhere, shown as itself (D-142): a command in a terminal, or a one-time code to enter on GitHub, in monospace with its own Copy. l: the code large, a step's focal point. Its label says where it goes, above it.

c_VersionCompare.description: A version found against the version needed (D-142): two small pills with an arrow between, the found one toned as a problem, instead of a sentence. Each pill says what it is.

c_StrengthMeter.description: How strong a passphrase is, shown under its field (D-142): four segments filled and toned by strength (weak, fair, strong), and one word or short phrase beside them. A meter to assistive technology.

c_Stack.description: Children in a column, spaced by a space token.

c_Inline.description: Children in a row, spaced by a space token.

c_Columns.description: Children side by side in equal columns while each has room (layout.sheetMin), one under the other when it doesn't (D-142): two short fields on one row, so a setup step fits the window.

c_Surface.description: A background, border, radius, and shadow. Frost works only inside a floating Layer.

c_Layer.description: Places content on a layer (trigger, panel, dialog, toast, tooltip) at a fixed position.

c_Center.description: Centers content up to a maximum width, with the page gutter.

c_AppRoot.description: The root of every app view. Applies the theme and the token modes to the document.

c_ToolbarRow.description: A row with the toolbar role: one tab stop, with arrow keys, Home, and End moving between its items.

c_Field.description: Label, control, description, and error in one arrangement; the group is named by the label.

c_Positioner.description: Anchors floating content to a range in the note (the selection or a link): never covering it, kept on screen, and following it as it scrolls.

c_Sheet.description: A side sheet over the canvas (Files on the left, Theme and Find in all notes on the right). Not modal; closes on Esc or a click on the canvas.

c_ReaderPage.description: A published page (IA-VIEW-PUBLIC): a skip link, the reading column as the page's main landmark, and a quiet footer. It follows the reader's light or dark preference and reads from 320 px wide.

c_EditorSurface.description: The writing surface (Tiptap and ProseMirror). It owns the note's DOM; views place it once.

c_TableControls.description: Loop-style table controls drawn over the note from the editor's geometry: row and column handles with menus and drag to reorder, the + insertion point, New row and New column bars, the column tint, the range outline, and the cell menu.

c_WindowFrame.description: The app-built window's behavior on Windows and Linux (D-14): moving by the title bar band (with double-click to maximize and right-click for the system menu), showing the window controls while the pointer is on the band (in full screen, once it reaches the top edge), the resize handles on every edge and corner, and the app-drawn system menu. The window's shape and shadow are AppRoot's `frame`.

c_Trigger.description: The trigger at the top center. Opens the toolbar under itself, and shows a save problem in its dot.

c_Toolbar.description: The trigger's toolbar: at most six command actions, then ⋯ with everything else (UI-04).

c_Dialog.description: A titled modal dialog with a close button, optional fixed controls, and a scrolling body.

c_NoteContent.description: A note's content through the block components (paragraphs, headings, lists, task lists, quotes, code, tables, rules, inline marks, and unknown syntax), read-only: the published reader page's note (IA-VIEW-PUBLIC).
